name: RMIT Indigenous Resource Grant
summary: One-off help for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander RMIT students with placement, technology, material fees and professional development costs.
key: Up to $3,000 for unpaid placements, plus smaller amounts for fees, technology and conferences.
who: Identifies as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander and is an Australian citizen.
Has discussed their situation with a Ngarara Willim Centre advisor.
how: Complete the online application with supporting evidence.
catches: Applications may close at any time.
Can't be received for the same item twice in a year.

evidence.quote: Unpaid WIL placement assistance of up to $3,000
